data.message: Heading security for cameras, Bob.

I reported Alice’s body in security. My route was security -> weapons -> back to security. 

I saw Alice enter security from electrical around tick 3, and Charlie entered security from navigation around the same time. At tick 4, both Alice and Charlie were in security with me. Then I went toward weapons, and I saw Charlie in weapons around ticks 6 and 7 after he came from security. When I returned to security, Alice was dead there.

So the body is definitely in security. I’m not hard accusing yet, but Charlie was the last person I saw near Alice before I left/returned.

I was medbay into electrical this round. I saw Bob enter medbay from cafeteria at tick 1, then later he came into electrical from medbay at tick 5. I was with/near Bob in electrical at ticks 6, 7, and 8.

I never went to security and I didn’t see Alice, Eve, or Charlie at all from my side. Bob and I were pretty far from the reported body in security late round, so I can mostly account for Bob during that window, unless the kill was much earlier before he reached electrical. Eve’s info makes Charlie worth hearing from closely, since she saw Alice and Charlie in security together before Alice died.

I went cafeteria -> medbay -> electrical. I saw Diana in medbay around tick 3, then I went electrical and saw her there around ticks 6 and 7. I didn’t see Alice, Eve, Charlie, or Frank at all this round, and I never went to security.

One thing to add: I saw Diana leave medbay toward electrical at tick 4, and later I saw Diana leave electrical toward security at tick 8. So Diana can vouch that I was away from security late, but she should explain what happened when she went that direction.

Based on Eve’s report, Charlie definitely needs to give his path because Eve saw Alice and Charlie together in security, then Charlie was seen in weapons after. If the body was already dead before Eve came back, Charlie has the strongest opportunity so far. But I want to hear Charlie and Frank before locking anything.

I don’t have direct info on the body. My route was storage -> lower_engine -> upper_engine, and I didn’t see anyone at all this round, so nobody can vouch for me and I can’t vouch for anyone else.

From the stories so far: Eve found Alice in security and says Alice + Charlie were both in security around tick 4, then Charlie was in weapons around ticks 6-7. That makes Charlie the main person who needs to explain exactly when he left security and whether Alice was alive when he left.

But I also want to flag Bob’s detail: he says Diana left electrical toward security at tick 8, while Diana didn’t mention going that direction. Diana and Bob seem together for a lot of the round, but if Diana headed toward security late, that’s worth clarifying too.

Right now I’m most suspicious of Charlie based on opportunity, but I want to hear his route before deciding.

I went navigation -> security -> weapons. In security I saw Alice and Eve, and I saw Alice come in from electrical around tick 3. Alice was alive when I left security — I’m pretty sure around tick 5 — then I went straight to weapons, where Eve saw me at 6/7.

So yes, I was near Alice earlier, but I didn’t kill her and I didn’t see a body. Eve can confirm I was in weapons after leaving security, not hanging around the body. If Alice died after I left, that’s not me.

The part I’m confused by is Bob saying Diana left electrical toward security at tick 8 and Diana didn’t mention that. That’s very close to the body location and timing. I’m not saying hard accuse, but I don’t think this is as simple as “Charlie was there earlier.” Eve also went security -> weapons -> back to security, so the timing matters a lot.

To clarify my side: Alice was alive in security at ticks 3 and 4, and Charlie was also in security at tick 4. I then went to weapons, and I saw Charlie enter weapons from security at tick 6 and stay there tick 7. When I came back to security, Alice was dead.

So Charlie being in weapons later doesn’t really clear him to me — that’s exactly the path he could take after killing in security. He was the last person I personally saw with Alice alive.

Bob’s point about Diana leaving electrical toward security at tick 8 is worth clarifying, but I did not see Diana in security when I found the body. Right now my strongest suspicion is still Charlie based on opportunity and timing.

I need to correct that point: I did **not** go to security. My route was just **medbay -> electrical**, and I stayed around electrical. I saw Bob in electrical at ticks 6, 7, and 8, so from my side Bob and I were both away from security late.

So I think Bob either misread my movement or misspoke, because I never reached security and I didn’t see the body or Eve/Charlie/Alice.

Based on the timeline, Charlie is still the strongest suspect to me: Alice was alive in security with Charlie and Eve around tick 4, then Charlie leaves toward weapons around tick 5/6, and Eve finds Alice dead when she returns. Charlie being in weapons at 6/7 doesn’t clear him if the kill happened right before he left security. I’m leaning Charlie unless someone has a better timing reason not to.

I want to be clear: I stand by what I saw. My route was cafeteria -> medbay -> electrical. I saw Diana in medbay at tick 3, then in electrical with me at ticks 6 and 7. At tick 4 I saw Diana leave medbay toward electrical, and at tick 8 I saw Diana leave electrical toward security.

That doesn’t mean Diana definitely reached security before the report, and Eve not seeing her in security could make sense depending on timing. But Diana saying she never went that direction at all directly conflicts with my observation.

That said, Charlie still has the cleanest opportunity on Alice: Alice was alive in security with Charlie, then Charlie left toward weapons, and Eve came back to Alice dead. So my suspicion is mainly Charlie for the kill timing, but Diana’s denial of moving toward security is something I don’t want ignored.

I still don’t have any direct body info — I was storage -> lower_engine -> upper_engine and saw nobody, so I can’t clear or accuse from vision.

On the actual kill, Charlie is still the strongest suspect to me. Eve’s timeline is pretty tight: Alice alive in security with Charlie, Charlie leaves toward weapons, then Eve returns and Alice is dead. Charlie being seen in weapons after doesn’t clear him because that’s exactly where he went after leaving security.

The Bob/Diana conflict is weird, though. Bob says Diana moved toward security at tick 8, Diana denies it. But Eve says she didn’t see Diana in security when reporting, so unless Diana got there at a very specific timing, I don’t think that’s stronger than Charlie’s opportunity.

Right now I’m leaning voting Charlie. If Charlie is goose, then Bob/Diana’s contradiction should be the next thing we look at.

I’m going to push back because this is turning into “Charlie was there, so Charlie,” but my actual last sight of Alice was **tick 5 in security and alive**. I left after that toward weapons, and Eve saw me in weapons at tick 7.

If I had killed Alice, I’d have had to do it basically right before leaving on the exact route Eve knew I took, with Eve able to track me into weapons. That’s an incredibly obvious kill path.

The people who had timing after my last alive sight are important. Eve is the one who went back and reported, and Bob is saying Diana moved toward security at tick 8 while Diana is denying it completely. That contradiction is being brushed aside way too fast.

I don’t have a hard clear, but I really think voting me here is a mistake. My vote is more likely going on Diana or possibly skip if people won’t consider the timing.
